cli.io-generated-docs.engine-page-whole.why: Without it, a regression where the generator needs the committed page to render would pass unnoticed.

cli.io-generated-docs.engine-page-writte.why: Without it, a regression where the engine page is not part of the generated outputs would pass unnoticed.
